home-assistant.name: Home Assistant
home-assistant.description: One reading from Home Assistant, such as a room temperature or whether a door is open. It shows on the notch when the value needs your attention.
home-assistant.privacy: Atap connects to your Home Assistant server at the address you give and listens to the topic you pick. Messages stay in memory only. Your password is kept locked on this PC.
home-assistant.brokerHint: The computer that runs your MQTT broker, such as homeassistant.local or 192.168.1.10.
home-assistant.topicHint: Where the reading is published, such as homeassistant/sensor/living_room_temperature/state.
home-assistant.label: Name to show
home-assistant.labelHint: Such as Living room. Leave it empty to show Home Assistant.
home-assistant.unitHint: Shown after the number, such as °C or %.
home-assistant.fullAtHint: The value that fills the bar.
home-assistant.alert: Show on the notch when it gets high
home-assistant.alertHint: The widget takes the notch while the value is at or above the level you set.
home-assistant.alertAtHint: For a bar, this is a percentage of the full bar.
home-assistant.portHint: Leave it at 0 for the usual port: 1883, or 8883 with a secure connection.
home-assistant.secureHint: Needed for a broker on the internet. Without it, Atap connects only to computers on your home or office network.
home-assistant.passwordHint: Atap keeps it locked on this PC and never shows it again.
home-assistant.field: Part of the message to show
home-assistant.fieldHint: For messages in JSON, such as $.temperature. Leave it as $ to show the whole message.
home-assistant.needsSetup: Add your broker address and a topic in this widget's settings.
home-assistant.badField: The part of the message to show is not written right. Check it in this widget's settings.
home-assistant.waiting: Connected. Waiting for the first reading…
home-assistant.retrying: Cannot reach the broker. Trying again soon.
home-assistant.signInRefused: The broker did not accept the user name or password.
home-assistant.needsTls: This broker is on the internet. Turn on a secure connection under More options.
home-assistant.pausedSaver: Paused to save battery. It carries on when the notch shows it.
